question: Which of the following is a public sector asset?

options.text: Tata Iron and Steel Company Limited

solution:
The correct answer is __**Post office.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Government-run** postal service India Post** is branch of the** Department of Post **under the **Ministry of Communications.**
 
• It is generally referred to as **Post Office **and is the most widely used postal service in the entire world.
 
• On behalf of the East India Company, **Warren Hastings **took the initiative to start the country's first mail service in **1766**.
 
• It was once referred as** "Company Mail."**
 
• Lord Dalhousie modified it and turned it into a Crown service in **1854.**
 
• With Dalhousie's support, the 1854 India Post Office Act, which marked a significant improvement over the earlier **1837 Post Office Act **and created regular post offices in India, was approved (universal service).
 
• It established the position of the **Director General **of **Post **for the entire country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Tata Iron and Steel Company Limited:**

 
 
• **​**Jamshedpur, Jharkhand is the home of the global **Indian steel manufacturer **Tata Steel Limited, which also has its corporate office in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• It belongs to the **Tata Organization.**
 
 
 
• **Ranbaxy Laboratories Limited:**
 
 
• **​**Incorporated in India in 1961 and operating till 2014, Ranbaxy Laboratories Limited was an international **pharmaceutical corporation**.
 
• In **1973**, the business went **public**.
 
• Over the course of its existence, Ranbaxy has experienced **two ownership **changes.
 
 
 
• **Reliance Industries Limited:**
 
 
• **​**With its headquarters in Mumbai, **Reliance Industries Limited **is **multinational conglomerate corporation **in India.
 
• **Energy, petrochemicals, natural gas, retail, telecommunications, mass media, **and **textiles **are just few of the many industries it operates in.
 
 

de:T
